ntowns.name: Hungerford
ntowns.why: Antiques town with 100+ dealers on one High Street. Dreweatts, a major auction house, is 15 minutes away.
ntowns.travel: Train from Paddington, about 1h05 (some trains change at Reading). Car: M4 J14, about 1h30.
ntowns.bestDay: Wednesday (charter and indoor market) or the antiques fair on the 2nd Sunday of each month in the Town Hall.
ntowns.dates: Antiques fair Sun 8 Nov and Sun 13 Dec. Dreweatts Fine Jewellery 18 Nov, Fine Watches 19 Nov.

ntowns.name: Tetbury
ntowns.why: The Cotswolds' antiques capital, with top dealers along Long Street, a Bonhams office in town and estate money all around.
ntowns.travel: Train from Paddington to Kemble, about 1h15, then a 15-minute taxi. Car: M4 J17, about 2h.
ntowns.bestDay: Wednesday (market day). Pair it with a Moore Allen & Innocent sale day in Cirencester.
ntowns.dates: Moore Allen & Innocent live sale Thu 5 Nov.

ntowns.name: Petworth
ntowns.why: A small Sussex town packed with fine-antiques dealers, many in the local dealers' association (PAADA), next to the Petworth estate.
ntowns.travel: Train from Victoria to Pulborough, about 1h15, then a 15-minute taxi. Car: A3 then A283, about 1h45.
ntowns.bestDay: Tuesday to Saturday, when most dealers are in. The Antiques Market is open 7 days.
ntowns.dates: Toovey's (20 minutes away) holds regular specialist sales. Check tooveys.com before you go.

ntowns.name: Lewes
ntowns.why: A long-running weekly auction (Gorringe's), Cliffe High Street's antiques centres, and 230-year-old Harvey's Brewery.
ntowns.travel: Direct train from Victoria, about 1h05. Everything is walkable from the station.
ntowns.bestDay: Monday: Gorringe's weekly sale, with the room full of dealers and executors. Farmers' market 1st and 3rd Saturdays.
ntowns.dates: Gorringe's Fine Art & Interiors Tue 3 Nov. House & Garden sale Mon 9 Nov.

ntowns.name: Henley-on-Thames
ntowns.why: A wealthy riverside town with an auction house, two rare-book dealers, a family jeweller and a boatyard family firm dating from 1870.
ntowns.travel: Train from Paddington, changing at Twyford, about 1h. Car: M4 J8/9, about 1h15.
ntowns.dates: Check The Pedestal's sale calendar. Viewing days are the easiest time to chat.

ntowns.name: Bicester Heritage
ntowns.why: A former RAF base with 50+ classic and supercar specialists, including Broad Arrow (auctions), Hagerty (valuations and insurance) and car-collection managers.
ntowns.travel: Train from Marylebone to Bicester, about 50 min, then a 5-minute taxi. Car: M40 J9, about 1h15.
ntowns.bestDay: A Scramble Sunday, when every workshop opens to the public. On other days, book visits ahead.
ntowns.dates: Scramble Sun 10 Jan 2027, Super Scramble 24–25 Apr 2027, Scramble Sun 3 Oct 2027.

ntowns.name: Cobham & Weybridge
ntowns.why: Surrey's supercar belt: Brooklands, a classic-car auction at Mercedes-Benz World, a 1979 family jeweller, and your dealer partner Scuderia Prestige nearby.
ntowns.travel: Train from Waterloo to Weybridge, about 30 min, or to Cobham & Stoke d'Abernon, about 35 min. Car: A3/M25 J10, about 45 min.
ntowns.bestDay: Saturday 28 Nov: Historics' Brooklands Velocity sale (viewing 26–27 Nov).
ntowns.dates: Historics at Mercedes-Benz World Sat 28 Nov.
